PSL_APPROX_LOCATION.reason: User-selected streaming country; optional YouTube trailer requests expose IP-derived general location under Google privacy practices. No device location permission is requested.

PSL_NAME.reason: Chosen nickname or optional GoodWatch display name. Guests can use the default name.

PSL_EMAIL.reason: Optional support correspondence and account-support requests. GoodWatch handles authentication email on its own website; YepWatch does not receive it in the account link.

PSL_USER_ACCOUNT.reason: Room participant identifiers and optional verified GoodWatch account identifiers identify the correct membership and protect room access.

PSL_USER_INTERACTION.reason: Room participation, votes, matches and decisions; optional YouTube playback interactions are handled by Google under its privacy policy.

PSL_IN_APP_SEARCH_HISTORY.reason: Optional viewing-idea/search prompts used to obtain catalog suggestions.

PSL_USER_GENERATED_CONTENT.reason: Optional room-authored viewing ideas; interpretation processors act as service providers. Sharing ideas with the invited room is an intentional user action.

PSL_CRASH_LOGS.reason: Expo Update failed-update identifiers and short launch-error reports, as documented by Expo.

PSL_DEVICE_ID.reason: Required random Expo installation ID and room-allowance identifier; optional YouTube player cookies/identifiers under Google privacy practices. YepWatch does not send its own room credentials or account identifier to the player.

thirdPartyPlayer: Google/YouTube collection is included, rather than assuming a user-initiated-sharing exemption. Expo and interpretation processors are treated as service providers.
selectiveDeletionReason: The published flow deletes all YepWatch data, with a 30-day recovery window, while preserving the separate GoodWatch account. No granular partial-data deletion control is offered.
